projects.name: AI Course Generator
bullets: Built a full-stack web application where users enter any topic and Google Gemini automatically generates a complete online course with 3–6 modules and individual lessons.
Developed a dynamic lesson viewer supporting rich content including text, coding sections, interactive quizzes, and video suggestions.
Integrated the YouTube Data API to automatically find and embed relevant educational videos for each generated lesson.
Implemented a PDF export feature using html2canvas and jsPDF, allowing users to save generated lessons and quizzes for offline study.
Built authentication and persistent course storage using MongoDB and Mongoose, allowing users to securely save and access their generated courses.

projects.name: Interactive Whiteboard Application
bullets: Developed and deployed an interactive whiteboard application on Vercel, enabling browser-based sketching, annotations, and freehand illustrations using HTML5 Canvas.
Implemented 7+ drawing tools including brush, line, rectangle, circle, arrow, text, and eraser using custom mouse-event handling.
Engineered centralized state management using React Context API and useReducer, supporting real-time canvas updates and history-based undo/redo with keyboard shortcuts.
Integrated Rough.js and Perfect-Freehand for hand-drawn shapes and smooth freehand strokes, with customizable colors, fills, brush sizes, and text formatting.

projects.name: Tic-Tac-Toe AI with Minimax and Alpha-Beta Pruning
bullets: Built a C++ Tic-Tac-Toe AI using the Minimax algorithm with Alpha-Beta pruning to optimize move selection and reduce unnecessary game-state evaluations.
Designed an efficient game-state evaluation function and implemented move ordering, iterative deepening, and transposition tables to improve search performance.
Optimized board representation using bitwise operations, reducing memory requirements while maintaining fast game-state evaluation.
Developed a modular console-based interface and conducted performance benchmarking across 10,000+ simulated games to validate AI correctness and efficiency.
